_comment: Privacy filtering for Beeper message extraction. Copy to beeper-config.json and customize. Add contacts or chat patterns to exclude from extraction.

excluded_contacts._example: Add display names of contacts whose conversations should be fully excluded.
excluded_contacts.name: Example Contact

service_config._comment: Enable or disable extraction per messaging service. Only enabled services will be scanned.

twitter._comment: Usually skip - Twitter data extracted separately via archive/API

signal_whitelist._comment: If non-empty, only these Signal chat IDs will be extracted. Leave as empty array to extract all Signal chats.
